_readme: Fast Agent owns the session mode IDs. Both languages read the mode that a default setup reports. Fast Agent modes select configured agents, and the native session reports them on the modes channel. LeapMux owns the BypassPermissions option ID: the worker uses it to select the native --no-permissions launch flag, and the browser uses it for the Bypass preset. Changing that flag requires a process restart. Native bash and process tool results can be recovered from root-session archives. The archive table supplies the provenance keys retained in those ACP packets; the tool IDs and timestamps come from the native archive, because live ACP packets use unrelated call IDs. Native Google audio format membership is the audioMimeTypes subset of attachment-media; browser and worker consume the same subset. The worker checks the running native provider before forwarding audio.
